# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Welcome
# to Aetna International
# 
# 
# 
# **Where simplicity, access and value unite to give you quality care and support, everywhere you
# need us**

[One girl smiling]

# Health & Wellness

Learn about the well-being resources available to help support your physical and mental health.
[Visit our health & wellness resources][42]

 

## Healthier happens everywhere

Aetna International provides simplicity, access and value for globally mobile members — ensuring
they have access to quality care and support wherever they are in the world. With the combined
resources of CVS Health® and Aetna®, we deliver:

 
* Unrivaled provider network access in 200+ countries and territories
* 100% coverage for eligible medical care outside the U.S.

 

 

## Let’s get you to the right place

 

It’s so nice to meet you. To start your journey with us, choose the audience that best fits you.
* ### [Providers][43]
  
  Whether you're new to our network or a long-time participant, find easy management of claims,
  payments and reimbursements — ensuring you can focus on caring for your patients.
* ### [Employers][44]
  
  From comprehensive onboarding to consistent support, our complementary plan designs and simplified
  health care terminology ensure a smooth experience for you and your employees.
* ### [Brokers][45]
  
  Enjoy early access to plans and product information, digital firsts and quoting tools. Access
  resources to give your clients the coverage they need to stay on a path to better health.
* ### [Governments | IGOs | NGOs ][46]
  
  We're the global expert in your corner who truly understands the cultural differences and
  similarities around the world, while providing solutions that help your team manage their health.

[A happy family together. A man smiling while holding his wife and son, with a small girl in the
background.]

## Members

With one digital front door for accessing plan information and health services, you can enjoy an
enhanced member experience with simpler processes and no or low-cost out-of-pocket costs. Find
unrivaled access to care — anywhere, anytime — through the member website and our worldwide
telehealth services.

[Explore our member solutions ][47]

## Helping our members live their healthiest

We’re here for our members through every step of their health journey. We offer health and wellness
resources that meet our members where they are, so they can get the care they need, the way they
want it.


[Health and wellness support][48]
* [A woman wearing a burka stretching on a yoga mat in front of a laptop on the floor.]
  
  ### Well-being resources
  
  Get help with improving or maintaining physical health.
* [A woman reading a red book smiling.]
  
  ### Mental well-being
  
  Find guidance for mental and emotional health.
* [An asian young man talking on the phone while traveling.]
  
  ### Global resources
  
  Learn how to navigate health care outside the U.S.

[Pre- and post-assignment coordination]

#### Your healthcare go-to-market starts here.

[Book a Demo ][30]
HCP Lookup

### Find and contact any healthcare provider in the US.

Your reps spend hours tracking down a physician and still end up leaving a voicemail with someone
who has no idea who makes decisions. Ampliz gives them a verified email, direct phone, and full
practice data for any provider in the US, filtered by specialty, ownership, and procedure codes.

Executive & Decision Maker Search

### Reach the people who control purchasing, budgets, and operations.

The VP of Operations at a 300-bed hospital is not in your CRM. Ampliz is. Search any title, filter
by seniority, department, facility type, and EHR vendor, and give your reps a direct line to the
person who actually controls the budget.

Hospital & Organization Analytics

### Full account context before you make the first call.

Your reps are walking into accounts with no context on who runs what, what tech they use, or how big
they are. Ampliz gives them the org chart, EHR stack, financial data, bed count, and IDN
relationships before they make the first call.

Data Enrichment Engine

### Your existing list, filled in and verified.

You have a contact list. Probably with missing emails, dead numbers, and people who changed jobs six
months ago. Upload your file and Ampliz returns it fully enriched and verified against 20M+
healthcare contacts in minutes.

NPI Lookup

### Turn an NPI number into a full outreach-ready profile.

You have NPI numbers but nothing attached to them your reps can use. Every match returns a full
outreach-ready profile: specialty, location, email, phone, LinkedIn, procedure codes, and Medicare
claims.

GTM Activation

### Go from verified contacts to active pipeline, without switching tools.

Export directly to HubSpot, Salesforce, or any CRM your team already uses. Or let Ampliz run warm-up
sequences and multi-touch cadences, and hand your reps only the contacts who engaged. No more cold
outbound into a list nobody touched.

run through NCOA. When sources conflict, a researcher investigates manually.

immediately, though.

What is the ANR process, and is it safe?

long-term opioid use and works to restore the endorphin–opioid receptor system to its pre-dependency
state.

hospital environment with a specialized medical team, ANR is designed to meet the needs of each
patient with a high level of oversight and care. You can read more [here][47].

alcohol and related health issues. During a medically supervised hospital stay that typically lasts
approximately three days, the patient’s withdrawal symptoms are managed with medication while other
fundamental medical needs are assessed so that appropriate referrals and discharge planning can be
completed after the patient has been fully stabilized.

recovery in a comfortable and therapeutic setting. Our experienced medical and clinical staff focus
on treating the patient using evidence-based, individualized, treatment practices to address the
substance abuse as well as any other concerns that may be contributing to the addiction. Residential
treatment centers offer a variety of services including detox, rehab, abstinence based and
medication-assisted treatments available, sober living options, partial hospitalization programs,
intensive outpatient program, and other services to support ongoing recovery.

# Move beyond addiction.

## We’ll walk with you.

Same-day medication assisted treatment. Community support. A compassionate partner at every step of
your recovery journey.

[ Call or text START to (866) 679-0831 ][46]
[ Start your journey ][47]
[Two people hugging]
[pill bottle icon]

#### Opioid addiction treatment

Let’s work together to find you the right combination of counseling, community support, and
life-saving medication.

[ Learn more » ][48]
[meditation icon]

#### Alcohol addiction treatment

Work with a care team who understands your journey. If medication is part of your recovery plan, we
can help with that too.

[ Learn more » ][49]
[helping icon]

#### Mental health care

We’ve got you covered with support to help you manage co-occurring conditions.

[ Learn more » ][50]
[heart in box icon]

#### Responsive care

We’re here to treat the whole you. From STI care to pain and fevers, we’ll respond to your health
needs. 

[ Learn more » ][51]

## How does it work?

We’re ready when you are to make this as fast and easy as possible.

[phone icon]
A quick intro call to help us help you

You’ll tell us about yourself and your health concerns. We’ll tell you about our treatment program.

[chat icon]
Chat with a healthcare provider

If we sound like the right fit, we’ll dial-in a member of our care team right away.

[calendar icon]
Start treatment that same day

We’ll get you a prescription, schedule your first counseling visit, and help you start feeling
better today.

[ Learn more ][52]

## It’s all covered by insurance

Our treatment is included in the benefits of your Medicaid, Medicare, or other health insurance
plan.

No insurance? No worries. We offer an affordable self-pay program.

### Do I need a prescription to order medication online?

A valid prescription is required for all applicable prescription medications. You are responsible
for ensuring the product is legal to import and use in your country. Our website does not provide
medical advice — always consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting any treatment.

### What payment methods do you accept?

We accept cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and more), bank transfer, Zelle, CashApp,
MoneyGram and Western Union. All transactions are handled securely, and your billing descriptor is
kept neutral for complete privacy.

### How long does delivery take, and is the packaging discreet?

Standard worldwide delivery takes 7–14 business days, express 3–7 business days, and domestic US
orders arrive in 2–5 business days. Every order ships within 24–48 hours in plain, unbranded,
tamper-evident packaging with a neutral return address — nothing reveals the contents.

### Do you offer free shipping, and do I need insurance?

Yes — free discreet worldwide shipping is automatically applied to all orders over $500, and no
insurance is ever required. We offer affordable direct pricing with frequent savings for insured and
uninsured customers alike.

### What is your refund and returns policy?

Every order is backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee. If your order is lost in transit, arrives
damaged, or is shipped incorrectly, you are eligible for a full refund or a free reshipment. Contact
our 24/7 support team with your order number to start a request.

### Can I track my order?

Absolutely. Once your order is dispatched we email you a tracking number, and you can follow your
parcel any time on our Track Order page or by contacting our support team for a live update.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about our pharmacy services

### Do I need a prescription to order medication online?

A valid prescription is required for all applicable prescription medications. You are responsible
for ensuring the product is legal to import and use in your country. Our website does not provide
medical advice — always consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting any treatment.

### What payment methods do you accept?

We accept cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and more), bank transfer, Zelle, CashApp,
MoneyGram and Western Union. All transactions are handled securely, and your billing descriptor is
kept neutral for complete privacy.

### How long does delivery take, and is the packaging discreet?

Standard worldwide delivery takes 7–14 business days, express 3–7 business days, and domestic US
orders arrive in 2–5 business days. Every order ships within 24–48 hours in plain, unbranded,
tamper-evident packaging with a neutral return address — nothing reveals the contents.

### Do you offer free shipping, and do I need insurance?

Yes — free discreet worldwide shipping is automatically applied to all orders over $500, and no
insurance is ever required. We offer affordable direct pricing with frequent savings for insured and
uninsured customers alike.

### What is your refund and returns policy?

Every order is backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee. If your order is lost in transit, arrives
damaged, or is shipped incorrectly, you are eligible for a full refund or a free reshipment. Contact
our 24/7 support team with your order number to start a request.

### Can I track my order?

Absolutely. Once your order is dispatched we email you a tracking number, and you can follow your
parcel any time on our Track Order page or by contacting our support team for a live update.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

into a single forecast you can act on.

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions

  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

[Founder]
Dmytro Shulha
CEO and Founder of GetProspect

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

Please, let me know if we can do something even better. 

Show more
[Team]

### Bootstrapped by a small team with a big passion for tech

[More about us][34]

# Make a new

# Act request**

[Make a request »][10]

## Search over
## **34,601 requests** and
## **3,184 authorities**

## Your **Right to Know**

Everyone in New Zealand has the right to access information held by public bodies. **By law, they
have to respond**.

[Supported by your donations][11]

## How it works

You have the **right** to request information from most publicly-funded bodies, and get answers. FYI
helps you make a request for Official Information. It also publishes all requests online.
1. Use this site to make your request for information – we'll show you how.
   
   1
2. We'll drop you an email as soon as your request gets a response.
   
   2
3. We publish it all online. Great! Now you have your answer, and everybody else can access it too.

in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.

Oro House Recovery Centers is Joint Commission Accredited, which is considered the addiction
industry’s Gold Standard for safety and client care.

In addition, we are Legit Script certified, and licensed by the California Department of Healthcare
Services (DHCS), so our clients can be confident we provide the highest level of safe and effective
care.

We are also certified to offer [Incidental Medical Services][92] (IMS), which is a supplemental
medical oversight service for our inpatient clients in the residential level of care.

## Oro House Addiction Treatment Programs in Malibu and Los Angeles

Highest Quality Clinical Care

## Dual Diagnosis Treatment

A substance use disorder of addiction combined with a mental illness like depression is known as a
**co-occurring disorder**, or **dual diagnosis**.

Some people use drugs or alcohol to cope with a mental health issue, while others are addicted to a
substance that causes them to become depressed or develop an anxiety disorder.

Each person is different, and the reasons behind their addiction or mental health issues must be
identified and properly addressed at the same time.

Our [dual diagnosis treatment program][93] is lead by licensed Doctorate and Masters clinicians with
a background in both psychiatric and addiction medicine to effectively treat and heal both
conditions simultaneously for a successful and lasting recovery.

## Professional Executive Program

The Oro House [Professionals Program][94] is customized for executives and professionals with a
substance use or mental health disorder, yet are high functioning with respect to the workplace and
their family life.

One of the main goals is for our professional clients to get back on track and return to a normal
life as quickly as possible.

The professional executive program can be tailored to the particular needs of this specialized
clientele, and is offered as inpatient or outpatient treatment several days a week.

## Non-12 Step Rehab

The Oro House [non 12 step rehab program][95] is not based on the ubiquitous 12-step rehab methods
of treatment used by countless other addiction facilities.

We understand there are many paths to recovery, and the 12-step model is only one of them.

We realize that some of our clients have had a poor experience at other drug and alcohol recovery
centers that rely on the 12-step model.

It is our view that a 12-step support program works best as a maintenance tool “after” appropriate
treatment has been completed, instead of during treatment.

We are happy to introduce our clients to it post treatment.

Because each of our clients has their own unique needs and circumstances, our goal is to work with
them on a personal level to identify the best tools and therapies that will guide them on their own
road to recovery from substance addiction.

Our experience has confirmed that drug and alcohol treatment is most effective when it is focused on
a **non 12-step model** of high-quality, evidence-based clinical care that is grounded in the most
current and up to date treatment research.

All of our [treatment therapies and modalities][96] are research-based and proven to be the most
effective for lasting recovery.

## Drug and Alcohol Detox

Oro House offers our clients in-house, evidence-based medical protocols for safe and comfortable
[drug and alcohol detox][98] to manage unpleasant withdrawal symptoms.

Detox is often the first step of recovery, and also one of the most important.

Because many treatment centers are not qualified to provide detoxification services, their clients
must undergo detoxification at a separate facility first before returning to begin the residential
phase of treatment.

**Our comprehensive program provides detox AND addiction treatment at our facilities, which leads to
improved continuity of care for our clients and more effective treatment.**

Oro House detox is private, confidential, and comfortable, providing a smooth transition to ongoing
services after the process has been completed.

## Young Adult Treatment Program

The Oro House [Young Adult Treatment Program][99] is specifically designed to cater to the unique
challenges faced by young adults with a drug or alcohol addiction, as well as a mental health dual
diagnosis disorder.

We have developed a program that resonates well with the struggles young adults face today, and we
are continuously crafting this emerging model of treatment using the latest innovations in recovery.

Our treatment team understands that a highly skilled and passionate staff is the single most
important ingredient to our program’s success with the young adults who come into our care.

Each of our staff members has been chosen for their rare ability to engage with, and relate to our
clients.

We believe the magical moments of connection and transformation that occur between our treatment
team and our clients will create the positive change they will remember forever.

## Holistic Treatment for Addiction

**Oro Houses uses a holistic approach to healing for drug and alcohol addiction recovery.**

Holistic treatment focuses on the Mind, Body, and Soul together, to decrease stress and boost
immunity for healing more quickly and improving overall health.

A holistic approach includes incorporating healing strategies that support the whole person.

**Some of the holistic healing methods we use at Oro House include:**
* Yoga
* Meditation
* Massage
* Surfing
* Sound Baths
* Gardening at Oro Farms

Rather than subscribing solely to the disease model of addiction, which often reduces individuals to
their diagnoses, we address the whole person because each client has his or her own unique story.

We believe a compassionate and intensive style of care helps us to better know and understand our
clients leading to more effective treatment outcomes.

## Oro House Addiction Treatment Programs in Malibu and Los Angeles

Highest Quality Clinical Care

## Dual Diagnosis Treatment

A substance use disorder of addiction combined with a mental illness like depression is known as a
**co-occurring disorder**, or **dual diagnosis**.

Some people use drugs or alcohol to cope with a mental health issue, while others are addicted to a
substance that causes them to become depressed or develop an anxiety disorder.

Each person is different, and the reasons behind their addiction or mental health issues must be
identified and properly addressed at the same time.

Our [dual diagnosis treatment program][93] is lead by licensed Doctorate and Masters clinicians with
a background in both psychiatric and addiction medicine to effectively treat and heal both
conditions simultaneously for a successful and lasting recovery.

## Professional Executive Program

The Oro House [Professionals Program][94] is customized for executives and professionals with a
substance use or mental health disorder, yet are high functioning with respect to the workplace and
their family life.

One of the main goals is for our professional clients to get back on track and return to a normal
life as quickly as possible.

The professional executive program can be tailored to the particular needs of this specialized
clientele, and is offered as inpatient or outpatient treatment several days a week.

## Non-12 Step Rehab

The Oro House [non 12 step rehab program][95] is not based on the ubiquitous 12-step rehab methods
of treatment used by countless other addiction facilities.

We understand there are many paths to recovery, and the 12-step model is only one of them.

We realize that some of our clients have had a poor experience at other drug and alcohol recovery
centers that rely on the 12-step model.

It is our view that a 12-step support program works best as a maintenance tool “after” appropriate
treatment has been completed, instead of during treatment.

We are happy to introduce our clients to it post treatment.

Because each of our clients has their own unique needs and circumstances, our goal is to work with
them on a personal level to identify the best tools and therapies that will guide them on their own
road to recovery from substance addiction.

Our experience has confirmed that drug and alcohol treatment is most effective when it is focused on
a **non 12-step model** of high-quality, evidence-based clinical care that is grounded in the most
current and up to date treatment research.

All of our [treatment therapies and modalities][96] are research-based and proven to be the most
effective for lasting recovery.

## Drug and Alcohol Detox

Oro House offers our clients in-house, evidence-based medical protocols for safe and comfortable
[drug and alcohol detox][98] to manage unpleasant withdrawal symptoms.

Detox is often the first step of recovery, and also one of the most important.

Because many treatment centers are not qualified to provide detoxification services, their clients
must undergo detoxification at a separate facility first before returning to begin the residential
phase of treatment.

**Our comprehensive program provides detox AND addiction treatment at our facilities, which leads to
improved continuity of care for our clients and more effective treatment.**

Oro House detox is private, confidential, and comfortable, providing a smooth transition to ongoing
services after the process has been completed.

## Young Adult Treatment Program

The Oro House [Young Adult Treatment Program][99] is specifically designed to cater to the unique
challenges faced by young adults with a drug or alcohol addiction, as well as a mental health dual
diagnosis disorder.

We have developed a program that resonates well with the struggles young adults face today, and we
are continuously crafting this emerging model of treatment using the latest innovations in recovery.

Our treatment team understands that a highly skilled and passionate staff is the single most
important ingredient to our program’s success with the young adults who come into our care.

Each of our staff members has been chosen for their rare ability to engage with, and relate to our
clients.

We believe the magical moments of connection and transformation that occur between our treatment
team and our clients will create the positive change they will remember forever.

Holistic treatment focuses on the Mind, Body, and Soul together, to decrease stress and boost

A holistic approach includes incorporating healing strategies that support the whole person.

**Some of the holistic healing methods we use at Oro House include:**
* Yoga
* Meditation

* Surfing

We believe a compassionate and intensive style of care helps us to better know and understand our
clients leading to more effective treatment outcomes.

# Advanced Pain Management Solution In The Woodlands

Pain MD Houston are experts in the latest and most comprehensive pain management treatment therapies
to help patients at all stages and with all types of complex, acute, and chronic pain.

[Dr. Mukalel][158] is dedicated to finding solutions for your pain syndromes. Having already
completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine in Pittsburg, as well as having been the Director of
the University of Texas at Houston’s Orthopedic Anesthesia, Acute Pain Service and Fellowship in
Acute Pain and Regional Anesthesia as well as the Bayfront Health System’s Chief of Pain Medicine
and Obstetrical Anesthesia

## PAIN THERAPY

#### JUST.GOT.BETTER

In response to injury or inflammation, cells at the site of pain release a number of biochemical
mediators. It’s our job to pinpoint the root of those issues to provide the correct treatment
therapy for your unique issue.

Our nerves signal pain response to our brains and the most important thing your Interventional Pain
Physician can do is “get to the root of the problem”. Without a full understanding of your pain,
it’s virtually impossible to know which of the hundreds of treatment options are most likely to
provide a positive outcome.

# Advanced Pain Management Solution In The Woodlands

Pain MD Houston are experts in the latest and most comprehensive pain management treatment therapies
to help patients at all stages and with all types of complex, acute, and chronic pain.

[Dr. Mukalel][158] is dedicated to finding solutions for your pain syndromes. Having already
completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine in Pittsburg, as well as having been the Director of
the University of Texas at Houston’s Orthopedic Anesthesia, Acute Pain Service and Fellowship in
Acute Pain and Regional Anesthesia as well as the Bayfront Health System’s Chief of Pain Medicine
and Obstetrical Anesthesia

## PAIN THERAPY

#### JUST.GOT.BETTER

In response to injury or inflammation, cells at the site of pain release a number of biochemical
mediators. It’s our job to pinpoint the root of those issues to provide the correct treatment
therapy for your unique issue.

Our nerves signal pain response to our brains and the most important thing your Interventional Pain
Physician can do is “get to the root of the problem”. Without a full understanding of your pain,
it’s virtually impossible to know which of the hundreds of treatment options are most likely to
provide a positive outcome.

Pain MD Houston provides a variety of pain management treatments, including spinal cord stimulation,
ketamine therapy, and various injection therapies, specifically tailored for patients experiencing
chronic and acute pain in the Woodlands area.

##### How can I schedule an appointment at the pain management clinic in Woodlands, TX?

You can schedule an appointment by calling Pain MD Houston at 346-272-0025 or by visiting their
website to fill out a contact form.

##### What types of pain conditions do you treat at your Woodlands pain relief center?

The clinic treats a range of conditions including back pain, joint pain, migraines, and neuropathic
pain, utilizing advanced techniques in pain management treatment in Woodlands.

##### Are the treatments at Pain MD Houston personalized for each patient?

Yes, treatments are individualized based on the specific needs and conditions of each patient,
ensuring effective pain management tailored to their circumstances.

##### What is the experience level of the staff at Pain MD Houston?

Dr. Mukalel and his team have extensive experience in interventional pain medicine, with Dr. Mukalel
having completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine and holding leadership roles in various medical
institutions.

##### What should I expect during my first visit to the pain management clinic in The Woodlands?

During your first visit, you will undergo a comprehensive evaluation to discuss your medical history
and current pain issues, followed by recommendations for appropriate pain management treatment
options.

##### Do you offer any minimally invasive procedures for pain treatment in Woodlands, TX?

Yes, Pain MD Houston specializes in minimally invasive procedures such as spinal cord stimulation
and various injection therapies designed to alleviate pain without extensive recovery times.

Betrouwbare informatie over acute en chronische pijn voor patiënten, zorgverleners en
wetenschappers. De oorzaken van pijn en de behandelingen van pijn worden uitvoerig besproken.   

Deze website is onder beheer van het Universitair Pijn Centrum Maastricht (UPCM). Dit is onderdeel
van het Maastricht UMC+ en heeft van het World Institute of Pain (WIP) de hoogst mogelijke
onderscheiding gekregen, de zogenoemde Excellence in Pain Practice Award for Comprehensive
Multidisciplinary Pain Practice. Er zijn wereldwijd slechts enkele andere pijncentra die deze
onderscheiding gekregen hebben. Met name de multidisciplinaire werkwijze van het Maastrichtse
pijncentrum wordt door het WIP geroemd.

Looking for straight‑forward advice on medicines, supplements, or a specific condition? You’ve
landed in the right spot. We break down complex topics into bite‑size tips you can actually use,
whether you’re managing joint pain or hunting for the best online pharmacy.

## What We Cover

Our articles span five core areas: Health, Pharmacy, Medications, Supplements, and Conditions. From
the anti‑inflammatory power of Iporuru to safe ways to buy Ventolin online, each post is written to
answer the questions you’re asking right now.

## Why Trust Our Guides?

We combine up‑to‑date research with real‑world experience. Every piece includes dosage basics,

Our Top Picks
* ### Sesame
  
  [Sesame logo]
  
  Sesame offers personal care for telehealth patients. Doctors are local to you and you’re able to
  schedule a visit in-person or virtually–whichever fits your schedule best.
  
  [Learn More][34]
* ### BetterHelp
  
  [BetterHelp logo]
  
  BetterHelp connects patients with reputable mental health professionals through secure phone,
  video, or live chat sessions for professional and convenient mental and behavioral health therapy.
  As a BetterHelp affiliate, we may receive compensation from BetterHelp if you purchase products or
  services through the links provided.
  
  [Learn More][35]
* ### Hims
  
  [Hims logo]
  
  Hims is an online health provider dedicated to helping men with various issues. Whether you’re
  hoping to lose weight, reduce your anxiety, improve your sexual performance, or regrow your hair,
  Hims is here to help. In-person visits are not required – you’ll receive all the assistance and
  support you need through the Hims app.
  
  [Learn More][36]

[A black woman, smiling at a desk that has flowers and a pride flag displayed on it.]
Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

UMass Memorial earns recognition as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader, demonstrating its
commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn More about Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][155]
[A little girl high-fives the doctor in Urgent Care having had her ankle bandaged and a bad scrape
treated.]

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]
[A woman waves hello to a group of people in an online meeting.]
7.20.26 | Support Groups

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

Join us on Monday, July 20, with special guest Carisa Lozoraitis, Cancer Quality Program Manager at
the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]
[A CRNA in an operating room, smiling and looking at the camera.]

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.
